**H1-2C-BASE resolved: Lectura i (ADR-0022 baseRefOid first, H1-3 dev in parallel via injected deps.baseSha, PR gated on widening)**

**What**: Owner (csrinaldi) ruled H1-2C-BASE on #266 comment 5008243569 → **Lectura i** (confirmed in-session 2026-07-17). Path:
1. Draft **ADR-0022** (`baseRefOid` on `prView`, additive, null fail-safe — the ADR-0021 pattern) into brain-drafts/. HUMAN promotes + signs (ADR-0020/0021 pattern). Port code gated on promotion.
2. **H1-3 checkpoint evaluator (Phase 10) develops NOW in parallel**, written against an injected `deps.baseSha` seam (testable via injection). The reversion check (task 10.4, `git checkout <base> -- <impl-files>` → require new tests FAIL) consumes deps.baseSha, NOT ci-context directly.
3. H1-3's **PR does NOT open** until ADR-0022 widening lands. H1-2C-BASE **closes** with the widening. Reversion works in CI AND local from day one — no degraded dimension ships, no rework (one wire to the port verb, not ci-context-then-rewire).

**Why Lectura i over ii**: (1) no shipping a degraded headline defense; (2) zero rework (deps.baseSha injected once, prod points at port verb on promotion); (3) no wall-clock cost (dev runs parallel to promotion); (4) aligns with Track H doctrine (widen the port properly, no ci-context coupling for base).

**Where**: openspec/changes/issue-266-h1-brain-review/tasks.md Phase 10; worktree /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-266-h1-3 branch feat/issue-266-h1-3-checkpoint (branched off #279 merge 44b88be, clean). tranche.mjs:10-22 documents the pre-existing base-unresolvable fail-closed rule.

**Next**: draft ADR-0022 + build Phase 10 evaluator (strict TDD, ~280 lines, med-high budget). Pin a durable .memory/records/ record for this decision (§8/§12 memory-trade — cold reviewer boots from records, not this engram note). Related: [[sdd/issue-266-h1/apply-progress]].
